title: Final Response V1.0
description: The deliberated content produced by Basic Knowledge: the text to be uttered, the Communicative Functions that go with the text (what the A-User means to do with its body, towards whom or what and with which words), the Actions that go with the text (for instance moving the Persona in the M-Instance) and the Process Actions that carry out the response, which may be more remote from the text. It is the only output of Basic Knowledge, apart from the AUC-BKN Response and the exchanges with its partners, and it is sent to A-User Formation.

AUCBKNRequestID.description: Identifier of the AUC-BKN Request to which the Final Response answers.

DialogID.description: Identifier of the dialogue (the Model Context Protocol session) in which the Final Response was deliberated.

Text.description: The text to be uttered by the A-User.

Actions.description: The Actions of MMM-TEC V2.2 that the A-User performs and that go with the text, typically on its own Persona (for instance MM-Animate to move the Persona in the M-Instance).

FunctionLevel.description: The Level of the Final Response. 0: no Communicative Functions. 1: Communicative Functions without Behaviour. 2: Communicative Functions, each of which may carry the Behaviour that realises it. It is not higher than the Level that A-User Control requested in the AUC-BKN Request. Absent: Level 0.

CommunicativeFunctions.description: What the A-User means to do with its body while it utters the Text: each function from the closed list of Functions, anchored to words of the Text, with its Target (the User, or an Item or an M-Location given in the PC Prompt), its Intensity and its Requirement and, at Level 2, possibly its Behaviour. The times are given by A-User Formation, not here.

ProcessActions.description: The Process Actions, in the syntax of MMM-TEC V2.2, that carry out the response. Present only if A-User Control asked for them.
